messages:
Aisha: Heads up — pen test vendor requested temporary service account for log pulls. Need RBAC plan and KMS access pattern. Proposed window Tue 2024-05-07 09:00-11:00 UTC. Thoughts?

ben: Can we give readonly role on the logs bucket + readonly to keystore? Prefer ephemeral role via SAML or STS assume-role rather than a long-lived SA.

Carla: For KMS, we can create a Grant that allows only Decrypt on the evaluation key alias/pt-eval-key. We'll *not* allow GenerateDataKey or ScheduleKeyRotation. After the window we'll revoke the grant and rotate the envelope key.

Devon: SRE note — we'll snapshot audit logs to an evidence bucket before the window and set object lock/retention. Dry-run shows ~1.2GB for last 24h. Quick command I used:

  aws s3 sync s3://prod-audit/ s3://pt-evidence/ --storage-class STANDARD_IA --exclude "*.tmp"

Aisha: Exact checklist for assessors? Need guidance they can follow and the minimum scopes. Also can we ask vendor to limit scan rate (max 5 RPS) to avoid perf impact?

ben: Agreed. Add an EventBridge filter to only emit GetObject on /audit/* and CloudTrail ReadOnly events for the assessor role. Also add a bucket policy that restricts access by source IP range for the engagement.

pen-bot: deploy-bot created temp role 'pt-assessor-20240507' TTL 2h, grant id g-7a9f. See internal keystore note at /internal/keystore/pt-eval/grants#g-7a9f.

Carla: Confirming: grant g-7a9f allows kms:Decrypt on alias/pt-eval-key. No Encrypt/GenerateDataKey. I'll file rotation ticket SEC-3421 to rotate after evidence handback.

Devon: Ran a staging dryrun of the snapshot script. Transfer was slow — suggest precompress:

  tar -czf /tmp/evidence.tar.gz /tmp/audit/* && aws s3 cp /tmp/evidence.tar.gz s3://pt-evidence/ --acl bucket-owner-full-control

Aisha: For retest coordination: we'll hold a 30-minute ops bridge 24h after remediation is pushed. Vendor suggested 2024-05-08 for retest; propose 2024-05-08 15:00 UTC. Anyone blocked?

ben: No blocker. Our RBAC rollout plan: create role + grant in a canary namespace, run smoke, then flip. I'll document step-by-step in the runbook and link to SEC-3421.

Carla: Audit-proofing idea: capture sha256 + a signed envelope so we can prove integrity to the assessor. Example:

  sha256sum evidence.tar.gz > evidence.sha256
  kms sign --key-id alias/pt-eval-key --message-type RAW --message-file evidence.sha256 --signature-file evidence.sig

Devon: I'll export CloudTrail verification bundle and timestamp it; will also add a console watch rule to alert on any PutBucketPolicy or IAM changes during the window.

Aisha: Action items: ben = RBAC playbook + IP restrictions; Carla = create KMS grant + post-window rotation ticket; Devon = evidence snapshot script, precompress step, and alerts; I'll coordinate vendor scheduling, ops bridge, and handoff. Tagging @Carla @ben @Devon. :thumbsup:
